productReviews.reviewText: [VERIFIED_PURCHASE] 😊 <article>i chose the vela halo 389 after comparing it with carrying separate adapters for my phone, tablet, and storage drive. the compact shape takes less room in my bag, but the convenience disappears when several devices are connected. the adapter recognises one accessory without much trouble, then becomes unreliable when i add another. a drive may vanish while a second device is plugged in, forcing me to remove everything and start again. that reset is awkward in a meeting or while moving files between devices. the short cable also bends sharply beside a laptop, so the adapter never sits where i need it. a cheaper single-purpose adapter i already owned was slower in theory but far less frustrating in use. with the vela halo 389, connection behaviour changes from one session to the next. sometimes the phone charges while the storage device remains invisible; on another attempt the drive appears but the phone stops charging. i cannot tell whether the problem is the port, the cable position, or the number of connected devices. the casing gets warm during transfers, and the indicator light is too faint to explain what is happening. i have tried different sockets and restarted the devices, yet the same interruptions return. basic connection is possible, but there is no dependable pattern. the compact design is the only clear advantage in this comparison, and even that is weakened by the stiff cable and loose-feeling fit. the vela halo 389 has not replaced the separate adapters because i still carry backups whenever i need to move important files. its twelve-month warranty offers little relief from the repeated setup hassle. after weeks of ownership, the device feels more like an unreliable extra step than a practical solution for connecting several devices through one compact adapter. i regret the purchase and cannot recommend it for anyone who expects consistent multi-device use.</article> Reference: HORD004998 SKU: SKU-VEL00290 https://reviews.example/verified?source=p0&lang=en
